You want to know about WhatsApp in Open North Group? 🤔 Well, Open North is a Canadian-based organization that has developed a platform called Open North Groups, which allows users to create and manage their own groups, including WhatsApp groups! 📱

Open North Groups is an open-source platform that enables users to create private or public groups, with features like group chat, file sharing, and more. WhatsApp, being one of the most popular messaging apps, can be integrated with Open North Groups to enable seamless communication within the groups. 📈

So, if you're looking to create a WhatsApp group in Open North Group, you can definitely do that! Just head over to Open North Groups, create your group, and invite your friends or colleagues to join. Easy peasy! 🎉
